newsitem.title: USA: Motorola offers paging system in Nicaragua.
newsitem.headline: Motorola offers paging system in Nicaragua.

text.p: Motorola Inc said Monday it has agreed to install the first commercial FLEX protocol-based system in Nicaragua with ANET de Centroamerica.

ANET plans to expand the systems across the Central American region by the end of 1997, with international roaming available in El Salvador, Costa Rica, Guatemala and Honduras through satellite distribution and frame relay access.
Financial terms of the deal wre not disclosed.

"With the first Motorola FLEX protocol-based system installed in Nicaragua, we can begin to promote the benefits of high speed, high capacity paging in this emerging market," said Pablo Pereira, chief executive of ANET de Centroamerica.

Motorola's FLEX technologies include the ReFLEX and InFLEXion advanced messaging protocols. ReFLEX is a two-way high-speed wireless messaging protocol while InFLEXion is an advanced protocol that can transmit and store voice and complex data messages.
